name: filesystem
title: Filesystem
description: Read, write, and manage files in directories you allow. The reference MCP server for local file access.
capabilitiesNote: Can read, create, edit, move, and delete files and directories inside the folders listed in its arguments (by default your Desktop). Anything outside those folders is unreachable.

name: memory
title: Memory
description: Knowledge-graph-based persistent memory. Lets the assistant remember facts, entities, and relations across chats.
capabilitiesNote: Can create, read, update, and delete a persistent knowledge graph stored in a local file on your machine.

name: sequential-thinking
title: Sequential Thinking
description: Structured step-by-step reasoning tool for planning and working through complex problems.
capabilitiesNote: Records and revises sequences of reasoning steps. It does not access your files, network, or any external data.

name: everything
title: Everything (Test Server)
description: Reference test server that exercises every MCP feature: tools, resources, prompts, sampling, and logging.
capabilitiesNote: Demo server with sample tools (echo, add, long-running operations). Intended for trying out MCP, not for real data access.

name: github
title: GitHub
description: Work with GitHub repositories: issues, pull requests, files, search, and code management via the GitHub API.

env.description: A GitHub personal access token. The server can do everything this token is allowed to do — scope it narrowly.

capabilitiesNote: Can read and modify repositories, issues, and pull requests reachable with your access token, using your GitHub identity.

name: brave-search
title: Brave Search
description: Web and local search powered by the Brave Search API.

env.description: API key from the Brave Search API dashboard (https://brave.com/search/api/).

capabilitiesNote: Sends search queries to Brave's servers and returns web, news, image, and local business results. Your queries leave your machine.

name: everart
title: EverArt
description: AI image generation using EverArt models. Generate images from text prompts.

env.description: API key from your EverArt account.

capabilitiesNote: Sends your prompts to EverArt's servers to generate images. Prompts leave your machine; generated images are returned as URLs.

name: slack
title: Slack
description: Read and post messages, list channels, and manage threads in your Slack workspace.

env.description: Bot token (xoxb-…) from your Slack app. The server acts with this bot's permissions.
Your Slack workspace team ID (starts with T).

capabilitiesNote: Can read channel history and post, edit, and delete messages as the bot in any channel it has been invited to.

name: puppeteer
title: Puppeteer
description: Browser automation: navigate pages, take screenshots, fill forms, and execute JavaScript in a real browser.
capabilitiesNote: Launches a browser on your machine that can visit any URL, interact with pages, and run JavaScript, including on sites you are logged into.

name: exa
title: Exa Search
description: Web search built for AI: semantic search over the web with clean, parsed content. Hosted remote server — no install needed.
capabilitiesNote: Sends search queries to Exa's hosted service and returns web results and page contents. Your queries leave your machine.
